description: Encounters (spec sites.md, section 4.3): parties of several bands that travel to one place, stay a while together and go home. The gathering at Göbekli Tepe (Yang, 2026-10-21, issue 132).

encounters.en: Two neighbouring bands come to Göbekli Tepe to raise the stone ring and celebrate it, and again 900 years later to fill it with earth
encounters.de: Zwei benachbarte Gruppen kommen nach Göbekli Tepe, um den Steinkreis zu errichten und zu feiern, und 900 Jahre später, um ihn mit Erde zu füllen
encounters.source: Schmidt 2010, Göbekli Tepe – the Stone Age sanctuaries, Documenta Praehistorica 37
